Here is one of his arguments. Our modern notion of a function is an extensional one: if functions ⟦M⟧ and g have the same values for every argument, then ⟦M⟧ and ⟦M⟧ are identical with one another. spot.html_text: In both the intensional and extensional logic traditions, we see theories of complex terms. In the extensional tradition, disjunctive and conjunctive terms are interpreted by taking the union and intersection of classes. The conjunctive term ⟦M⟧ is interpreted as the intersection of the class ⟦M⟧ and the class ⟦M⟧ and the extension of the disjunctive term ⟦M⟧ is understood as the union of the extensions of ⟦M⟧ and ⟦M⟧ .
